translations.web: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
translations.bsb: His son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh, but his son by the free woman was born through the promise.
translations.kjv: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
translations.asv: Howbeit the son by the handmaid is born after the flesh; but the son by the freewoman is born through promise.
